run_cross_task_evaluation: run cross-task retrieval evaluation with a Contriever model on query and passage data
run_rerank_with_cross_encoder: rerank retrieval results using a cross-encoder model like T5 or BERT for re-ranking
run_evaluate_retrieval_metrics: evaluate retrieval results computing NDCG, MAP, Recall, and Precision metrics at multiple k values
run_embed_queries_with_contriever: embed queries into dense vectors using a Contriever model for vector search
run_index_passage_embeddings: index passage embeddings into a Faiss index for fast approximate nearest neighbor search
